iteration-count.title: animation-iteration-count
iteration-count.history: Controls how many times an animation repeats (number or infinite). Useful for loops and attention-grabbers.
iteration-count.quiz: Which property sets how many times an animation repeats?

animation-direction.title: animation-direction
animation-direction.history: Controls playback direction: normal, reverse, alternate (back-and-forth). Useful for oscillating effects.
animation-direction.code: ↺
animation-direction.quiz: Which property sets animation playback direction including alternate?

fill-mode.title: animation-fill-mode
fill-mode.history: Defines how an element styles before/after animation (forwards, backwards, both, none). Keeps end state when needed.
fill-mode.tip: Use 'forwards' to keep the final state.
fill-mode.code: Keeps final state
fill-mode.quiz: Which property controls element state before/after animation?

play-state.title: animation-play-state
play-state.history: Pause or resume animations via CSS or JS (running or paused). Useful for user controls and performance.
play-state.tip: Use 'paused' to stop an animation temporarily.
play-state.quiz: Which property pauses or resumes an animation?

timing-function.title: animation-timing-function
timing-function.history: Controls the speed curve of an animation: ease, linear, ease-in/out, or custom cubic-bezier for precise motion.
timing-function.quiz: Which property controls the animation speed curve?

steps.title: steps() Timing Function
steps.history: The CSS steps() timing function creates a stepped timing curve for animations, producing discrete jumps instead of smooth interpolation. It is commonly used for sprite animations, frame-by-frame transitions, and any effect that requires a fixed number of frames.
steps.tip: Use steps(n, start|end) to create discrete animation frames. 'start' changes frames at the beginning of each step, while 'end' changes at the end.
steps.code:
CSS steps() timing function — 5 frames
Smooth (linear)
steps(5, end) — frame changes at end of step
steps(5, start) — frame changes at start of step

How it works: steps(n, position) divides the animation into n equal intervals. Use end to advance frames at the end of each step (common for sprite sheets), or start to advance at the beginning of each step. This produces crisp, frame-by-frame jumps instead of smooth interpolation.
steps.quiz: Which timing function creates discrete animation frames instead of smooth interpolation?

multiple-animations.title: Multiple animations
multiple-animations.history: Run more than one animation on the same element by comma-separating animation declarations.
multiple-animations.tip: Use comma-separated animations in the animation shorthand to run multiple animations on one element.
multiple-animations.code: Multi animation
multiple-animations.quiz: How do you run multiple animations on one element?
multiple-animations.answer: Comma-separate animations in the animation shorthand

transform-animation.title: transform + animation
transform-animation.history: Combines CSS transforms (translate, rotate, scale, skew, translateZ) with CSS animations or transitions to create motion and 3D effects. Useful for interactive UI elements, micro‑interactions, and animated components.
transform-animation.tip: Use transform properties with @keyframes or transition to create smooth motion and 3D effects.
transform-animation.code:
Animated
Floating 3D Card

This card uses @keyframes with transform (translateZ, rotateY, scale) to create a looping 3D float effect.

Hover to Transform
Uses transition + transform for interactive tilt.
Tip: use transform-style: preserve-3d on parent and backface-visibility when layering 3D children. Combine @keyframes for continuous motion and transition for user interactions.
transform-animation.quiz: Which CSS features are combined to create continuous 3D motion and interactive tilts?

transform-3d.title: 3D Transforms (rotateX, rotateY, perspective)
transform-3d.history: 3D transforms let you rotate, translate, and scale elements in three-dimensional space. The perspective property (on a parent) controls the viewer distance and depth; rotateX and rotateY rotate elements around the X and Y axes respectively. Combine transform-style: preserve-3d, backface-visibility, and perspective to build realistic 3D UI effects and interactive cards.
transform-3d.tip: Use perspective on a parent container to control depth, and rotateX/rotateY for 3D rotation.
transform-3d.code:
Move the sliders or hover the card to see 3D transforms
Front Face
Back Face
Tip: perspective is set on the .scene element
transform-3d.quiz: Which properties are used to rotate elements in 3D and which property controls the viewer distance for perspective?

filter-animation.title: filter + animation
filter-animation.history: Animate filter effects (blur, hue-rotate, brightness) for creative image and UI transitions.
filter-animation.tip: Use filter with @keyframes to animate visual effects like hue-rotate, blur, and brightness.
filter-animation.code: Select this part with cursor and See the Magic of Css Animations.
filter-animation.quiz: Which property group animates blur, brightness, and hue changes?

clip-path-animation.title: clip-path + animation
clip-path-animation.history: Animate clip-path to reveal or morph shapes for creative reveals and transitions.
clip-path-animation.tip: Use clip-path with @keyframes to animate shape reveals or morphing effects.
clip-path-animation.quiz: Which property can be animated to morph or reveal shapes?

backdrop-animation.title: backdrop-filter
backdrop-animation.history: Animate backdrop-filter for glassmorphism effects (blur/saturate) on translucent panels; requires semi-transparent background.
backdrop-animation.tip: Use backdrop-filter with @keyframes to animate glassmorphism effects.
backdrop-animation.code: Glass panel (hover)
backdrop-animation.quiz: Which property blurs or affects the area behind an element for glass effects?

will-change.title: will-change
will-change.history: Hint the browser about upcoming animated properties (transform, opacity) to optimize rendering. Use sparingly.
will-change.tip: Use will-change to hint the browser about upcoming changes and optimize performance.
will-change.quiz: Which property hints the browser for upcoming changes to optimize performance?

blend-animation.title: mix-blend-mode + animation
blend-animation.history: Animate elements that use blend modes to create dynamic composite effects with the backdrop.
blend-animation.tip: Use mix-blend-mode with @keyframes to animate blending effects.
blend-animation.quiz: Which property blends an element with its backdrop and can be animated?

motion-path.title: Motion path (offset-path)
motion-path.history: Animate elements along custom SVG or basic paths using offset-path and offset-distance for complex motion.
motion-path.tip: Use offset-path to define a path and offset-distance to animate along it.
motion-path.quiz: Which property animates an element along a custom path?

scroll-snap-animation.title: Scroll-snap + animation
scroll-snap-animation.history: Combine scroll-snap with animations for smooth carousels and scroll-driven slide effects.
scroll-snap-animation.tip: Use scroll-snap-type on the container and scroll-snap-align on the children, combined with transition or @keyframes for animated effects.
scroll-snap-animation.code:
1
2
3
scroll-snap-animation.quiz: Which features combine for smooth snapping carousels with animated slides?

shape-outside-animation.title: shape-outside + animation
shape-outside-animation.history: Animate floated shapes to create dynamic text wrapping and magazine-style motion effects.
shape-outside-animation.tip: Use shape-outside with @keyframes to animate the shape that text wraps around.
shape-outside-animation.code: Animated float with text wrapping around the circular shape creates lively magazine layouts.

scroll-driven.title: Scroll-driven animations
scroll-driven.history: Bind animation progress to scroll position using @scroll-timeline and animation-timeline. Enables performant, declarative scroll-based effects without heavy JS.
scroll-driven.tip: Use @scroll-timeline to define a scroll-based timeline and animation-timeline to bind animations to scroll progress.
scroll-driven.code:
Scroll-driven header color
Scroll to see the header change based on scroll progress
scroll-driven.quiz: Which CSS at-rule defines a scroll-based timeline for animations?

anchor-position.title: CSS Anchor Positioning (animate tooltips/popovers)
anchor-position.history: Position and animate tooltips/popovers relative to another element using anchor positioning; syntax and support are evolving.
anchor-position.tip: Use anchor-name and anchor-position to position elements relative to an anchor element, combined with @keyframes for animation.
anchor-position.code: Tooltip near anchor (animated)
anchor-position.quiz: Which experimental feature positions and animates tooltips relative to another element?

houdini-animation-worklets.title: CSS Houdini Animation Worklets
houdini-animation-worklets.history: Animation Worklets let developers write JS-driven animations that run on a worklet thread (off the main thread) for high-performance, procedural animations. This API is experimental and may require a polyfill or a modern browser build to run.
houdini-animation-worklets.tip: Use CSS.animationWorklet.addModule() to register a JS worklet that defines a custom animator, then use the animator name in animation shorthand for high-performance animations.
houdini-animation-worklets.code:
Houdini Worklet
If your browser does not support Animation Worklets, open the console for a message.
houdini-animation-worklets.quiz: Which Houdini primitive lets you run JS-driven animations off the main thread for high-performance effects?

motion-path-l2.title: CSS Motion Path Level 2
motion-path-l2.history: Advanced motion path features (path syntax, offsets, rotation along path) for complex path-based animations.
motion-path-l2.tip: Use offset-path with advanced path syntax and offset-distance to animate elements along complex paths, including curves and rotations.
motion-path-l2.quiz: Which spec expands path-based animations with advanced path features?

color-level4.title: Color Level 4/5 animations
color-level4.history: Animate colors across perceptual color spaces (Lab, LCH, HWB) for smoother, more accurate transitions in design systems.
color-level4.tip: Use lch(), lab(), or hwb() color functions in @keyframes to animate colors in perceptual color spaces.
color-level4.quiz: Which new color specs enable perceptual color animations like LCH?
